import sys

    from collections import Counter
    
    # Count the frequency of each element in both multisets
    count_a = Counter(a)
    count_b = Counter(b)
    
    # Check if both multisets have the same set of unique elements
    if set(count_a.keys()) != set(count_b.keys()):
        return "NO"
    
    # Check if we can transform b into a using the allowed operations
    for key in count_a:
        if count_a[key] != count_b[key]:

    return "YES"
